opportunities.title: Small Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference is given to those not previously involved in UK‑Japan collaboration, especially early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 total) to support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering travel, conference and publication costs.
